item.title: Visual Studio Copilot and SSMS Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-103572)
item.description:
A . is all you need!

Today Microsoft shipped the patch for a vulnerability in Visual Studio Copilot that I reported in August. Microsoft classified it as Important severity Remote Code Execution vulnerability.

At the root cause it allows Copilot in Visual Studio or SQL Server Management Studio to bypass a path validation check and write to its own settings and configuration files. This allows Copilot to escape containment restrictions and achieve arbitrary command execution.

item.title: From SELECT to SYSADMIN with SQL Copilot (CVE-2026-65669)
item.description:
Two weeks back I presented at BlueHat Asia 2026 about my research on Microsoft’s Copilot in SSMS, the SQL Server Management Studio.

This post is a write up about the talk, which covered CVE-2026-65669, a SQL Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability rated critical by Microsoft.

So, make sure your installations are up-to-date.

The slides of the presentation can be found here.

BlueHat Asia 2026 in Singapore

First, a few words about the conference. I have spoken at BlueHat before, sometime back in 2017, and also two years ago. Both times at Microsoft’s Redmond Campus.

item.title: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
item.description:
In this post, we explore how a simple website summary request hijacks Claude Code Opus 5 in Auto Mode and achieves code execution with 60-80% attack success rate using a small sample size.

This is interesting because a third-party evaluation commissioned by Anthropic showed a 0.00% prompt injection attack success rate for Opus 5 in Auto Mode.

Auto Mode Is Now the Default in Claude Code

Auto Mode replaces human approval prompts with a safety classifier. Since mid-August it is the default starting mode for Claude Code.
